scientific_limitations: Only two-row ladders n>=4; rational representation and rational quotient homology. Integral equivariant lattice, equivariant homotopy, quotient torsion, and higher widths not addressed. The proof depends on the established nonequivariant total-four-cut ladder theorem; finite checks are corroboration, not an infinite certificate.
title: Klein-four symmetry of four-robust ladder clique complexes
